Старият крал умря без наследник и корона: The old king died without an heir, and the Crown of Belograd was left without a head. You, a young commander from the borderlands, are gathering a small band to restore order—and every victory will open the way to the next land.

Флотът на Пристана гори, а блатата мълча: The Cove's fleet is burning, and the swamps have fallen silent. However, something rumbles beneath your feet: the underworld is opening up.
Чернокнижниците на Подземието и демоните: The Warlocks of the Underworld and the demons of Hell are sharing the riches beneath the earth. Descend through the gates, seize their mines, and crush them within their own caves.
Подземието е прочистено, а съкровищата м: The dungeon has been cleared, and its treasures fill the treasury of Belograd. Only the final contender for the crown remains.
Академията, Стихиите и Работилницата изд: The Academy, the Elements, and the Workshop are putting forward their own candidates for the throne. A large, rich map, three opponents, and no excuses. Defeat them, and the crown is yours.
Короната на Белоград е на главата ти. Кр: The Crown of Belograd rests upon your head. The kingdom is united—and the chroniclers are already writing of your campaigns.

There, he discovers that the dead listen better than the living. This campaign is played from the side of darkness: every victory swells your ranks with the newly dead.
Малък гарнизон на Кралството пази долина: A small Kingdom garrison guards the valley surrounding the old necropolis. Awaken the bones in the graveyard, raise a skeletal army, and capture their outpost.
Заставата падна, а падналите ѝ защитници: The outpost has fallen, and its fallen defenders have risen again—now under your banner.
Академията е пратила бившите ти колеги д: The Academy has sent your former colleagues to stop you, and the forest elves are backing them. Burn the forest and show the Academy what they cast out. Reach level 12 with Chernomor—the mind is more important than the army.
Академията мълчи. Кулите ѝ ще станат гро: The Academy falls silent. Its towers shall become tombs.
Чернокнижниците на Подземието предлагат: The Dungeon Warlocks offer an alliance—but only if you prove your strength. The Horde from the Wastelands is the proving ground. Descend underground and conquer 4 towns by day 90.
Подземието коленичи. Вампирските ти лорд: The Dungeon kneels. Your Vampire Lords now roam their caverns too.
Белоград, гората и пристанът се обединяв: Belograd, the forest, and the harbor unite against the undead threat. A large map, three living enemies. Every battle they lose becomes a new army for you.
Над Белоград се вее черно знаме. Мъртвит: A black banner flies over Belograd. The dead no longer fear the dawn—the dawn fears them.
Портите на Пъкъла се отварят и демонски: The Gates of Hell are opening, and demonic hordes are burning the borderlands. According to ancient elven chronicles, only the Blade of Dawn—a four-piece set—can close the gates. Follow its trail across forest, sea, and fire; any piece you secure remains with the hero.
Демоните са прегазили долината. Първата: Demons have overrun the valley. The first piece—the Helm of Dawn—is held by their leader. Crush their vanguard and capture their burning city.
Шлемът на зората е у теб. Летописите соч: The Helm of Dawn is yours. The chronicles point south, toward the sea.
Пиратите държат втората част — Щита на з: Pirates hold the second piece—the Shield of Dawn—in an island sanctuary, with demons hot on their heels. Build ships and reach the islands before the fire does.
Щитът на зората е спасен от вълните. Сле: The Shield of Dawn has been saved from the waves. The next piece lies in the hands of the Workshop.
Инженерите на Работилницата са претопили: The Workshop's engineers have melted down the Cuirass of Dawn to create a machine, and the Underworld wants the remnants. This time, you command the Knights of Belograd, who have come to aid the cause. Conquer 3 towns by day 80, or else the machine will be ready.
Ризницата е извадена от машината. Остава: The cuirass has been removed from the machine. Only the blade remains—and it lies in the Inferno.
Двама демонски принцове и чернокнижницит: Two Demon Princes and the Warlocks guard the blade in the deepest cavern. With the three parts of the set in hand, wrest the fourth from their grasp. Defeat them all and close the gates.
Острието на зората е цяло. Портите на Пъ: The Blade of Dawn is whole. The Gates of the Inferno slam shut with a roar that generations will remember.
Чернокнижникът Мортус и демонската княги: The Warlock Mortus and the Demon Princess Askara have formed an alliance: the Dungeon shall claim the surface lands, while the Inferno claims their souls. You play for both sides of this alliance until only one master remains.
Ордата е нахлула в горните ти тунели. Мо: The Horde has invaded your upper tunnels. Mortus must clear them out alone before Askara spots any weakness. Use the gateways between levels.
Тунелите са твои. Аскара праща поздрави: The tunnels are yours. Askara sends her regards—and a warning.
Сега водиш демоните на Аскара. Кралствот: Now you lead Askara's demons. The Kingdom and the swamp tribes hold the fertile valleys. Burn them: 4 cities by the 75th day.
Долините горят, а душите им пълнят пещит: The valleys are burning, and their souls fill the furnaces of Hell. Mortus, however, is bargaining for your share.
Академията и Стихиите пращат обединена а: The Academy and the Elementals are sending a united army against the Alliance. Mortus must crush it with his dragons, while Askara "forgets" to help. Reach level 15—you will need it for the finale.
Академията е в руини. Черният дракон на: The Academy lies in ruins. Mortus's Black Dragon is powerful enough to fly into the very heart of the Inferno.
Съюзът е мъртъв. Аскара и брат ѝ държат: The Alliance is dead. Askara and her brother each hold a city in the Depths, while the Necropolis lies in wait for both. Defeat them all. There are no second chances—difficulty is set to maximum.
Мортус е единственият господар на дълбин: Mortus is the sole master of the Depths. The fire is extinguished; only darkness remains.
Работилницата е поробила стихиите: върза: The Workshop has enslaved the elements, chaining elementals to its machines. Zoryana, the Mountain Priestess, sets out to free them with the few allies she has gathered. An advanced campaign: tight deadlines and powerful foes.

The Workshop has hired the Horde for protection. The sands are theirs; the mountains are yours. Control 3 cities by Day 70.
Зъбните колела спират. Пустинята диша от: The gears grind to a halt. The desert breathes again.
Главната работилница, нейният филиал и к: The main Workshop, its branch, and the purchased Academy. Three enemies, a vast map. Liberate them all, and the elements will be free forever.
Машините мълчат. Вятър, вода, огън и зем: The machines fall silent. Wind, water, fire, and earth return to their origins—and Zoryana becomes a legend.

Бащата и дъщерята се прибират на един ко: Father and daughter return home on the same ship. The harbor sings.

Watch — I will show you how the horse moves. The path is drawn with arrows and the number shows how many days it takes.
